text: sd Mcu_Wakeup_FromMcuDriver | Mcu::Mcu EcuM::EcuM | ECU low power mode | Further operation and wake-up condition checking of ECU StateManager | Use case description: Before activating a low power mode of the MCU Driver, a callout to an ECU specific module is done to prepare sleep mode (Wakeup/Sleep Control). In this case the MCU Driver is armed to report the wake-up reason after wake-up. | After that, the MCU is set to low power mode. | After some time, the ECU is woken up. No ISR is activated. The MCU driver cecks the wake-up flag, detects that he is responsible for evaulation and reporting of the wake-up reason. | Comments: This solution is advantageous for microcontrollers that can wake-up without ISR execution and where the wake-up reason is derived from the interrupt status register or by later input pin evaluation of the ECU State Manager. | Example: cyclic timer wake-up, report of wake-up reason "CYCLIC_WAKEUP", scanning of inputs for ECU wake-up conditions | «Peripheral» Hardware::Wakeup | Source | Mcu_SetMode(McuMode) | Wake-up event (NOT an ISR) | Evaluate Wake-up reason (e.g. from interrupt status register) EcuM_SetWakeupEvent(events) | EcuM_SetWakeupEvent | Mcu_SetMode
